integrity: Analytic proof with explicitly bounded exceptional strata; executable numeric diagnostics are supplemental, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three independent uniform boundary points of one Euclidean circle; no general-host theorem.
Endpoint limits and marked laws are asymptotic, not finite-threshold equality.

title: Quartic circularity and square-root flattening for random Steiner inellipses
